description: Measured neuron soma positions, with annotated backbone anchors only where a soma is unavailable. Colours represent annotated cell groups, not neuropil meshes.

groups.label: Görsel nöronlar
groups.meaning: super_class optic, visual_projection or visual_centrifugal; or cell_class visual or optic_lobes

groups.label: Koku devresi
groups.meaning: cell_class olfactory, ALPN, ALLN, ALIN or ALON

coordinates.positionPreference: Complete soma_x/y/z triplet, otherwise complete pos_x/y/z anchor triplet
coordinates.normalization: (positionMicrometers - centerMicrometers) / scaleMicrometers; one uniform scale for all axes and both datasets
coordinates.orientation: Original annotation axes retained; x is the broad left/right axis. Positions are not mirrored, warped or projected onto synthetic regions.

provenance.sampling: Fixed budgets per annotated group; proportional side strata; deterministic FNV-1a root-ID ranking; all simulated circuit neurons retained.
provenance.citation: Schlegel et al., Whole-brain annotation and multi-connectome cell typing of Drosophila, Nature (2024), doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07686-5; current annotations also incorporate Matsliah et al. (2024) and Berg et al. (2025/2026), as documented by FlyWire.
provenance.limitation: Each dot is one measured soma/anchor, not a reconstructed arbor or the position of a synapse. Only the separate 699-neuron visual circuit is simulated; the other points provide anatomical context.
